title: Thai Shrimp Dumplings
description: A simple and delicious Thai-inspired dish made with shrimp dumplings, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine shrimp, coconut milk, curry paste, and tom yum sauce. Mix well.
2. Lay a dumpling wrapper on a clean surface. Place a tablespoon of the shrimp mixture in the center of the wrapper.
3. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
4. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
5. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
6. In a large pot of boiling water, cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
7. Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
8. Garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
